title: Successful login after repeated failures
description: A successful SSH login for analyst followed a burst of 5 failed attempts from the same source.
recommendation: Prioritize account-owner verification, review surrounding authentication activity, preserve relevant logs, and escalate according to the incident-response process.

title: Repeated SSH authentication failures
description: Observed 5 failed SSH authentication attempts from 203.0.113.45 within 5 minutes.
recommendation: Review the source and targeted accounts; confirm whether the activity is expected, then apply approved blocking or account-protection procedures if malicious.

title: Remote SSH login to root account
description: A successful SSH login to the root account was observed from a source outside common private/local address ranges: 203.0.113.60.
recommendation: Verify whether direct remote root access is permitted; review the account and source context, and prefer named accounts with least privilege where applicable.
